_comment_coordinatedManifests: Everything a coordinated major/minor platform release stamps to ONE version: the platform manifests plus the independently-versioned npm packages (each as <dir>/package.json). The platform-release orchestrator stamps these together; standalone publishers still use independentNpmPackages for one-off patches. NOTE: coordinatedManifests == units.host ∪ units.channels.
_comment_units: Release units (deployment bundles). The platform-release orchestrator releases by unit; each unit's manifests are stamped to ONE version and may drift independently of other units (CI's version-sync enforces intra-unit consistency, not cross-unit). 'host' MUST list package.json (root) first — CI anchors the host unit + the setup-script versions to root. assistant + voice are image-only (no npm manifest to stamp; their version is the Docker tag). full release == units.host ∪ units.channels (== coordinatedManifests).
